sentences.text: This Atlantic bluefin tuna was tracked for {days_tracked}, from {first_date} to {last_date}.
Atlantic bluefin tuna are warm-bodied fish that can cross the Atlantic, spawning mainly in the Gulf of Mexico and the Mediterranean.
Just days before its record ends, on {farthest_date}, it was {max_displacement_km} from where its track began.
